tldr: Neptune in the 6th house: longing becomes personal through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
body:
With Neptune in the 6th house, this part of you sensitizes work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress. Neptune describes longing, imagination, sensitivity, compassion, confusion, and the places where boundaries soften. In practice, this brings attention to the daily habits, tasks, workloads, and body signals that decide how sustainable life feels.

When this placement is supported, your days can become more honest, supportive, and manageable. Neptune can become empathy, imagination, spiritual openness, and the ability to sense what is not being said.

When it is strained, stress can become normal simply because you have learned how to function through it. The harder pattern can show up as avoidance, idealization, blurred boundaries, or believing the dream more than the evidence.
gift: empathy, imagination, spiritual openness, and the ability to sense what is not being said expressed through work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
challenge: avoidance, idealization, blurred boundaries, or believing the dream more than the evidence around work, health, routines, service, maintenance, and stress.
